image_description: A large, wall-mounted decorative object shaped like a vintage audio cassette tape. The object features a metallic or grey plastic frame with a central transparent window revealing two spools and magnetic tape. Above the window is a label area with stylized, partially illegible text resembling track listings. Below the window are two circular cutouts mimicking the spindle holes of a real cassette. To the right, a portion of a blue electronic device (possibly a synthesizer or mixer) is visible. At the bottom left, green leafy plant stems intrude into the frame. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.
